stemMd: A rise in thyroid hormone reduces secretion of thyroid-stimulating hormone in a normal regulatory axis. This relationship is an example of what?
explanationMd: The downstream hormone inhibits an upstream signal that normally stimulates its production. This counteracts further increases and stabilizes the system. The sign of the feedback is determined by whether the response opposes or amplifies the original change.

distractorRationale.a: Positive feedback would reinforce rather than oppose the initiating rise.
distractorRationale.c: That is a meiotic genetic mechanism.
distractorRationale.e: That is cell rupture caused by excessive water entry.
distractorRationale.d: That is an ecological concept rather than this endocrine relationship.
